description:
Game markets Polymarket settled, as 0xinsider recorded them, oldest first: one row per market per settled state, the same object the market_settled webhook delivers as data. Use it to catch up on settlements after downtime, as a pull alternative to the webhook (keep next_cursor and call again with it), or to find one market's or game's settlement by condition_id or event_slug. Each row carries condition_id, settlement_id (one per market per settled state), event_slug, game_id, league, sports_market_type, outcomes (labels at their outcome index), protocol_version (v1 for a ConditionalTokens market, v2 for a Polymarket Protocol V2 market, which redeems through the V2 modules: the new markets from 2026-11-09 and the polyv2 copies), copy_of_event_slug (the original's slug on a polyv2 copy of a game whose original has a moneyline; such a copy is listed only when condition_id or event_slug names it, as the webhook leaves it out of a filter that names neither; else null) and settlement: status observed, oracle_status resolved, settled true, payouts (micro-USDC per share per outcome index), result (outcome, or split for a 50-50), winning_outcome_index, was_disputed, resolved_at (null on a resolved UMA question row, which carries none), oracle_updated_at (Polymarket's last_update_timestamp, its latest lifecycle change, never a resolution time; on such a row, when UMA's answer settled the question), expected_settlement_time, settlement_time_basis and observed_at, when 0xinsider first saw this state. A market can appear twice: once as a question row without payouts, then again with them. Unlike the webhook, a state first recorded more than 6 hours after its market resolved is listed, and so is a state naming the winner an earlier state of its market named (Polymarket's payouts row after the ConditionalTokens payout). Every plan.

Args:
  - since (string, required without cursor): RFC 3339 time; rows whose settlement.observed_at is at or after it
  - sports_market_type (string, optional): comma-separated provider market types, case-insensitive (moneyline, spreads, totals, a prop type). Default moneyline, or every type with condition_id; * keeps every type, including markets with no stored type
  - league (string, optional): comma-separated leagues as the rows' league reports them, for example nba,epl; pga is PGA Tour golf
  - condition_id (string, optional): comma-separated market condition ids, at most 20
  - event_slug (string, optional): comma-separated event slugs, matched exactly, at most 10; a polyv2 copy has its own slug, for example polyv2-nba-phi-chi-2026-11-08
  - limit (number, 1-100, default 20)
  - cursor (string, optional): opaque stl_v1_ cursor from next_cursor. It replaces since and keeps the filters it was issued for; filters sent with it must match them

Returns: data, has_more, next_cursor, complete_through and meta. complete_through trails now by two minutes: rows observed at or before it are served, so a row is never passed before it is recorded. has_more true means more rows up to complete_through remain: call again with next_cursor now. has_more false means the walk reached complete_through: keep next_cursor and call again later for what is recorded after it. next_cursor is always present. A page can hold fewer than limit rows, or none, while has_more is true: a read that has not filled its page stops after about 120 ms of scanning and resumes on the next page. A 503 read_model_warming means the first read did not answer in time: retry after Retry-After.

condition_id.description: Comma-separated market condition ids, at most 20. With it, an omitted sports_market_type keeps every type

cursor.description: Opaque stl_v1_ cursor from next_cursor; it replaces since and keeps the filters it was issued for

event_slug.description: Comma-separated event slugs, matched exactly, at most 10; a polyv2 copy has its own slug

league.description: Comma-separated leagues as the rows' league reports them, for example nba,epl; pga is PGA Tour golf

since.description: RFC 3339 time, required without cursor: rows whose settlement.observed_at is at or after it

sports_market_type.description: Comma-separated provider market types, case-insensitive: moneyline, spreads, totals, a prop type. Omitted: moneyline, or the cursor's filter; * keeps every type
